title: [SUBS, Prime] Evangelion Movies 1-4 @ Amazon Prime Video
body:
Deal: [SUBS, Prime] Evangelion Movies 1-4 @ Amazon Prime Video

[Babbit] Good to watch 3.33 + 1.11 Thrice upon a time on but the first three movies use amazons dub which is well known for being worse than the Funimation ones.
[FujinShu] Wait, I wonder which anime has the most dubs for one language…
[dazzawul] Wouldn't shock me if it's an even split between eva and dragonball hey
[not boris becker] It's a real bummer that both Amazon and Netflix managed to screw up the new subs + dubs they produced (both likely due to the involvement of Dan Kanemitsu).
[DeToxin] They made their own subs?
Are they slightly different to the original theatrical release?
[not boris becker] Yep, both have either new sub tracks done by the Studio Khara translator I mentioned or dubtitles. Despite being a native English speaker, he's a poor writer with very literal translation priorities so the scripts come off feeling like ESL with grating nonsense like Shinji being the "Third Children" instead of "Third Child" (it's literally English チルドレン (chirudoren) in Japanese but ADV who handled the original release yonks ago told them that that was obviously unworkably stupid for the actual English version back then lol).
[Booshbosch] I watched the series and then the movies and pondered life for the next few days
[SoapyWooder] Don't watch if you struggle with anxiety and depression
[furythree] On one hand its one of the greatest anime ever
In the other hand, you get looked funny for being so excited about a story entailing so much death depression dread anxiety
But big robot go boom!
[netsev] Seems to me it's a death cult show disguised as an anime
[alexGoodwin] i thought it was about how to overcome the anxiety and depression
[CalmLemons] Just remember Shinji just needs a massive slap
[superroach] I mustn't run away .. from this sweet deal!
[silverrat23] Shinji get on this deal, or else Rei will have to do it.
[Jimothy Wongingtons] I sure hope shinji pilots the EVA, or Gendo says he’s coming back
[hugh] beware ccp china, japan has managed to contain the AT Field.
[Jimothy Wongingtons] I had to double check this wasn’t a skibidigrimmor67 post
[Switchblade88] Skibidi Grandma?
Is that Pam's alt account?
[Drakster] This isn't really an anime thing. It's a budget thing. Try watching a Ghibli film and you'll see some great animation.
[Roose4837] I've generally heard bad things about this, at least by those close to me. The anime feels overhyped from the story and the small snippets I've seen.
[Dollar Dreamer] And it has really bad animation like 2 fps, 70% still frames.
[Pacify] The original is a timeless classic, and incredibly influential. The rebuilds are (imo) not quite as good, but still excellent.
[godofpizza] for those who have not watched the tv series yet. Do you need to watch them in order to understand the movies? or are these something else?
[HerpinDerp] Nah, you can watch it. The OG tv series makes very little sense towards the end on the first watch.
If you like it you can go back and rewatch that, the remastered stuff and rebuilds. Then prep for the Nier/NGE series
[Pacify] I'd always say watch the original + end of eva first, the rebuilds just work better if you have already seen the original.
[highwind] Was gonna say, watching the OG TV series might reduce one's understanding lol
Nevertheless, worth watching and experiencing an absolute classic
[silverrat23] You don't need to watch the show to understand the movies.
The first two movies mostly recaps the TV series (remake), whereas the third and forth movies have original stories.
[godofpizza] so if you watch 3+4 are there spoilers on the tv series?
[jacross] No. The story diverges from the tv series/EoE.
[Meron35] TV Series + End of Evangelion Movie: Bad Ending
Rebuild Movies: Good Ending
They are better described as two different timelines of the same universe for which the Rebuild Movies are mostly similar to the first half of the TV series, then both diverge.
[HerpinDerp] I was keen to rewatch after the new series announcement. I'd also recommend people play Nier Automata and also get depression from the game too.
[hcl] Thanks for sharing the deal OP, but am I the only one who watched the OG anime series and felt utterly confused? Especially the last 2 episodes. Totally confused.
